facts.function: protective packaging insert holding a robotic arm during shipment
facts.form: custom-configured foam cut to profile with product-specific internal cavities (finished article, not sheet stock)

gri_path: GRI 1: articles for the conveyance or packing of goods, of plastics, heading 3923; the foam is cut and hollowed into a dedicated packing article, so it is no longer a plate/sheet of 3921
GRI 5(b) not needed: the inserts are imported as packing articles in their own right
GRI 6: 3923.90.00 other (not boxes, bags, carboys, spools, closures); suffix .80 other (not pails)

rejected_alternatives.reason: cellular plastic plates/sheets; the foam is cut to profile with product-specific cavities, making it a finished packing article
boxes, cases and crates; an insert is not a box
residual plastics heading; 3923 specifically covers articles for packing goods

classification.rationale: The polyethylene foam inserts are cut to profile and hollowed with cavities to hold and protect a robotic arm in shipment, which makes them articles for the conveyance or packing of goods of heading 3923 rather than cellular plastic sheet of 3921. CBP classified a plastic foam packing insert in 3923.90.0080 (NY H89540, in force). The residual statistical line .80 applies since they are not pails.
